kompliment.ok: A sincere, specific compliment showed her that you really see her.
kompliment.nein: A compliment works best when it is about something real and specific.

fragen.ok: She opened up a little, because you really listened.
fragen.nein: Asking something real shows interest. It lands best when she feels like talking.

necken.ok: She enjoyed the game, and the mood got lighter.
necken.nein: Teasing needs a light mood. It lands best when she is relaxed with you.

troesten.ok: You noticed how she felt, and that helped her.
troesten.nein: Comfort helps most when something really weighs on her.

entschuldigen.ok: Your honest apology cleared the air between you.
entschuldigen.nein: An apology means most when there is something to put right.

geheimnis.ok: You shared something real, and that brought you closer.
geheimnis.nein: A secret is a big step. It lands more easily once she knows you better.

hand.ok: She let you take her hand, and the moment felt closer.
hand.nein: Taking her hand is a small step. It needs a quiet, private moment.

umarmen.ok: The hug comforted her, and she felt safe with you.
umarmen.nein: A hug is close but warm. It suits moments when she needs support.

haar.ok: It was a small touch, but the moment felt closer.
haar.nein: This is a very personal touch. It lands better once there is some spark.

kuessen.ok: The kiss changed things, and you both share that moment now.
kuessen.nein: A kiss is a big step. It lands better when the mood is already close.

massage.ok: She relaxed under your hands and felt closer to you.
massage.nein: A massage asks for trust. It suits moments when she is tired and at ease.

einladen.ok: She said yes, so you have a date with her.
einladen.nein: An invitation is a clear question. It lands better once she enjoys your company.

gestehen.ok: You told her how you feel, and now she knows.
gestehen.nein: Saying how you feel is a big step. It needs trust and the right moment.

eifersucht.ok: You asked her straight out, and that cleared something up between you.
eifersucht.nein: This is a hard subject. It works best when she trusts you to listen.

versprechen.ok: She believes your promise, so now you have to keep it.
versprechen.nein: A serious promise means most once she believes you will keep it.

ausziehen.ok: She welcomed it, and you are both ready to go further.
ausziehen.nein: This asks for a lot of closeness. It lands more easily once she trusts you more.

vorspiel.ok: She enjoyed your touch, and she wants you close.
vorspiel.nein: Slow touch needs a relaxed mood. It lands better when she feels at ease.

schlafen.ok: You ended up together, and that moment stays with you both.
schlafen.nein: This is the biggest step of all. It needs trust, desire and the right moment.

wiederholt: Doing this twice in one talk has no effect. Try something else.

vertrauen.plus: She trusts you a little more after this talk.
vertrauen.minus: She trusts you less now. An honest talk or an apology can repair that.
vertrauen.gleich: Her trust stayed the same this time. Listening and being honest help most.
vertrauen.deckel: Talking alone won't build more trust here. A shared moment with her will.

begehren.plus: She is a little more drawn to you now.
begehren.minus: Some of the spark has gone. A light joke or small gesture can help.
begehren.gleich: The spark stayed the same this time. Playful words and closeness help most.
begehren.deckel: Talking alone won't raise the spark here. A shared moment with her will.
